post.title: Byderma
post.content: A WordPress and WooCommerce beauty platform that brings treatments, a large product catalogue, member benefits, booking and shopping into one consistent experience. On smaller screens, the same separation between treatment, shopping and booking remains easy to recognize and use.
post.excerpt: Task separation drives the beauty platform: discovery, appointments and ecommerce remain distinct while visitors can switch between them without losing context.

post.title: Tenbrugge
post.content: A professional WordPress website for Ten Bruggen that presents financial and accountancy services in a clear, trustworthy and accessible way. The website combines strong structure, responsive design and direct contact options to help visitors quickly find the right expertise.
post.excerpt: For Ten Bruggen, I created a modern and responsive WordPress website focused on clarity, credibility and conversion. Complex financial services were translated into an easy-to-navigate structure with clear service pages, strong calls to action and integrated appointment booking. The result is a professional website that supports both the brand and the customer journey.
